object:large box.visualDescription: A squat reddish wooden box has a flat golden lid, dark side planks, and a small metal front lock.
object:large box.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the large box as a lockable wooden container, smaller and simpler than a chest.
object:large box.modelBrief: Build a low rectangular wood box with bright hinged lid and centered gray lock plate.

object:chest.visualDescription: A taller dark wood chest has a curved gold-trimmed lid, black interior seam, and orange front lock.
object:chest.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the chest as a lockable wooden container related to the large box.
object:chest.modelBrief: Make a tall heavy chest with arched slatted lid, deep dark opening line, and conspicuous central latch.

object:ice box.visualDescription: A rectangular blue ice box has a bright cyan lid, pale front lip, dark hinge side, and deep blue base.
object:ice box.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the ice box as a plastic container for preserving food.
object:ice box.modelBrief: Build a hard-sided blue cooler with pale cyan hinged top and dark side hardware.

object:bag / sack.visualDescription: A tan drawstring sack has a narrow tied mouth, rounded body, darker seams, and flat base.
object:bag / sack.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the sack as an ordinary cloth container appearing as a bag.
object:bag / sack.modelBrief: Make one simple lumpy beige cloth bag with a dark tied neck; this appearance is shared by the nearby bag variants.

object:bag / oilskin sack.visualDescription: The tile repeats the tan tied sack, with rounded body and dark brown mouth.
object:bag / oilskin sack.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the oilskin sack as a cloth container that protects contents from water and appears as a bag.
object:bag / oilskin sack.modelBrief: Reuse the plain tan bag shape; any waterproof coating should be subtle and must not change the catalog appearance.

object:bag / bag of holding.visualDescription: The same pale tan drawstring bag sits upright with a small tied neck and broad lower body.
object:bag / bag of holding.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the bag of holding as a magical cloth container with unusual storage capacity.
object:bag / bag of holding.modelBrief: Reuse the ordinary bag appearance without depicting an oversized interior or magical glow.

object:bag / bag of tricks.visualDescription: A tan tied cloth bag has the same simple rounded silhouette as the other bag tiles.
object:bag / bag of tricks.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the bag of tricks as a magical cloth bag that can produce monsters when applied.
object:bag / bag of tricks.modelBrief: Reuse the plain sack model; keep the trick effect separate from the visible bag.

object:key / skeleton key.visualDescription: A gold skeleton key lies diagonally, with a round bow, narrow shaft, and two dark teeth.
object:key / skeleton key.wikiDescription: The wiki describes the skeleton key as an iron unlocking tool appearing simply as a key.
object:key / skeleton key.modelBrief: Model a small old-fashioned key with circular head and notched bit, using the tile's warm gold color.

object:lock pick.visualDescription: A thin dark-gray lock pick lies diagonally and bends into a tiny hook at one end.
object:lock pick.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the lock pick as an iron tool for opening locks.
object:lock pick.modelBrief: Make a narrow steel pick with straight grip and sharply bent working tip.

object:credit card.visualDescription: A small black credit card has a gold corner square and two pale rows of markings.
object:credit card.wikiDescription: The wiki identifies the credit card as a plastic lock-opening tool.
object:credit card.modelBrief: Build a thin black rectangle with gold chip-like patch and minimal pale printed stripes.

object:candle / tallow candle.visualDescription: An unlit white candle is a short diagonal waxy rod with pale cream edge and dark lower outline.
object:candle / tallow candle.wikiDescription: The wiki distinguishes tallow candle from wax candle by material, value, and shorter burning time; both are light sources.
object:candle / tallow candle.modelBrief: Make a small plain unlit ivory candle with no holder or flame, matching the paired candle tile.

object:candle / wax candle.visualDescription: The same small unlit white candle lies diagonally with cream highlight and dark edge.
object:candle / wax candle.wikiDescription: The wiki distinguishes wax candle from tallow candle by material, value, and longer burning time.
object:candle / wax candle.modelBrief: Reuse the plain unlit ivory candle model; material identity can differ without a visible shape change.
